CREATE VIEW DWH.DIM_Calendar AS 
WITH 
S1 (N) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2),
S2 (N) AS (SELECT 1 FROM S1, S1 B),
S3 (N) AS (SELECT 1 FROM S2, S2 B),
S4 (N) AS (SELECT 1 FROM S3, S3 B),
S5 (N) AS (SELECT 1 FROM S4, S4 B),
S6 (N) AS (SELECT 1 FROM S5, S5 B),
Nums (N) AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT 1)) FROM S6),
Dates (SATZ_ID, [Date]) AS
(
	SELECT N, DATEADD(dd, N - 1, CONVERT(date, '19800101'))
	FROM Nums
	WHERE 
	N <= DATEDIFF(dd, '19800101', '20401231') + 1
	UNION ALL SELECT 0, '19000101'
)
SELECT 
	SATZ_ID,
	[VeryShortDate] = CONVERT(varchar(5), Date, 101),
	[ShortDate] = CONVERT(varchar(8), Date, 1),
	[LongDate] = CONVERT(varchar(10), Date, 101),
	[Date],
	[Year] = YEAR([Date]),
	[Month] = MONTH([Date]),
	[Day] = DAY([Date]),
	[Week] = DATEPART(wk, [Date]),
	[Weekday] = DATEPART(dw, [Date]),
	[ISO_Week] = DATEPART(isowk, [Date]),
	[CurrentDate] = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(dd, Date, GETDATE()) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	[CurrentMonth] = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(mm, Date, GETDATE()) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	[PrevMonth] = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(mm, Date, GETDATE()) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	[CurrentYear] = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(yy, Date, GETDATE()) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM 
	Dates
